name.zh: 单手哑铃交替踏步抗侧屈

purpose.zh: 练侧腹和髋部，单侧负重下保持平稳
purpose.en: Build the obliques and hips to stay steady with weight on one side.

text.zh: 一手提哑铃，交替抬膝时骨盆保持水平
text.en: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and keep your pelvis level as you march
Keep your trunk upright without leaning.

text.zh: 抬膝不用太高，动作慢而稳
text.en: Lift your knees just a little, slowly and steadily.

commonErrors.en: Letting the pelvis drop on one side.

cautions.zh: 选能控制的重量，出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Choose a weight you can control, and stop if you feel pain.
